entities.name: AJG QA Test Management System
observations: This workspace contains a React and Vite frontend, an Express API, and a SQLite database.
The local implementation is a usable reference app; it does not claim to provide Microsoft 365 identity, SharePoint sync, Power Automate, Power BI publishing, Jira API access, or CI result ingestion.

entities.name: Architecture decisions
observations: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md is the source of truth for the recommended Microsoft 365 production architecture and capability boundaries.
Test runs store immutable JSON snapshots of selected test cases and steps.
SQLite is for local development and small-team evaluation; recommend SharePoint Lists or Dataverse with tenant-specific authorization for production.

entities.name: Development workflow
observations: Read docs/README.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md before changing the app or its data model.
Keep entities connected through stable prefixed IDs and record durable implementation decisions or verified gotchas in this project memory.
Do not put credentials, customer information, or sensitive company data in project memory.
